articles.title: Canada and EU announce new alliance open to like-minded countries
articles.highlight: 新伙伴关系名为“未来联盟”，加欧称其可提供“前所未有的稳定与机遇”。
articles.summary: 加拿大与欧盟在蒙特利尔峰会上公布“未来联盟”，称其既是为民众提供庇护的“保护伞”，也是对地缘政治不确定性的有力对冲，并欢迎其他志同道合国家加入。卡尼与冯德莱恩强调，加拿大与27国集团尽可能深入的合作有望带来前所未有的稳定与机遇。这有助于观察国际政治如何通过结盟来管理不确定性。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键点在于，这类联盟的价值更取决于能否把“稳定与机遇”的承诺转化为可执行、可持续的合作机制，而非仅看成员数量。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Alliance for the Future, unveiled at Montreal summit and open to other countries, conceived for world ‘shaken by new storms’ Canada and Europe have announced a new alliance of like-minded nations to serve as both a “protective canopy under which our citizens can thrive” and a powerful hedge against the unpredictable nature of geopolitics, while welcoming other countries to join. Speaking to reporters on Friday from Montreal, the prime minister, Mark Carney, and the European Commission president, Ursula von der Leyen, called the new partnership the Alliance for the Future and said the “deepest possible partnership between Canada and the 27-member bloc had the potential to offer unprecedented stability and opportunity”.

articles.title: Was I wrong about open models & cyber risks?
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: No clear evidence
articles.summary: 文章围绕作者提出的“黑色十月”概念，讨论一连串关键漏洞披露是否标志着AI模型的网络安全风险开始成为现实。它值得读，因为文章把开放模型与网络风险这一抽象争论，拉回到具体漏洞事件的时间线上重新检视。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键 takeaway 是：讨论AI安全风险时，应关注具体漏洞披露与模型开放程度的交汇点，而不是只停留在抽象担忧。
articles.highlight: 在PHP2Shell、GitLab等关键漏洞密集披露后，作者用“黑色十月”指称AI模型网络风险开始显现的时刻。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Last week coined the term “Black October“ after an onslaught of critical vulnerability disclosures, including PHP2Shell and GitLab, signified the moment when the cyber risks of AI models started to materialize.

en.summary: The article uses the author’s “Black October” concept to ask whether a wave of critical vulnerability disclosures signals that AI models’ cybersecurity risks are becoming real. It is worth reading because it grounds the abstract debate over open models and cyber risk in a concrete timeline of vulnerability events.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway is to examine where specific vulnerability disclosures and model openness intersect, rather than staying at the level of abstract concern about AI security risk.
